description: RFC 8621 §5.5.3 lists 'size' as a server-set property (immutable, must not be set by the client). build_email_from_create reads it: let size: u64 = obj_val.get("size").and_then(|v| v.as_u64()).unwrap_or(0). A client that sends size:0 in the create payload will have that value stored and echoed back. The server should ignore the field entirely and always set size=0 (or the real value from the blob), never accepting it from the client. Trigger: any Email/set create request that includes a 'size' key. Bad behavior: client-controlled size is stored and returned as a server fact.
title: Email/set create silently accepts client-supplied size
